fields.description: Sends every request to Safaricom's Daraja sandbox. Turn off once the keys are for your live Daraja app.
fields.label: Sandbox

fields.description: The Paybill number, or for Buy Goods the store (head office) number the passkey belongs to.
fields.label: Business Shortcode

fields.description: The till that receives the money.
fields.label: Till Number

fields.description: Needed only for refunds, which M-Pesa makes as transaction reversals.
fields.label: Refunds

fields.description: An API operator on the M-PESA Org Portal with the reversal role.
fields.label: Initiator Name

fields.description: The initiator's password encrypted with Safaricom's certificate, as the Daraja portal generates it.
fields.label: Security Credential

fields.description: Generated on save and added to every callback URL sent to M-Pesa, which does not sign its callbacks. Clear it and save to stop accepting callbacks for earlier payments.
fields.label: Callback Token

fields.description: Optional. One IP address per line; when set, callbacks from any other address are rejected. Safaricom publishes the addresses its callbacks come from.
fields.label: Callback IP Allowlist

fields.description: M-Pesa has no checkout page: the shopper gets a PIN prompt on their phone and is sent here straight away, while the payment is still Pending.
fields.label: Success URL

fields.description: M-Pesa never redirects here; it is the URL the storefront uses when a payment fails.
fields.label: Failure URL

fields.description: M-Pesa never redirects here; it is the URL the storefront uses when a shopper abandons checkout.
fields.label: Cancelled URL
